title: Chief of Staff
behaviour: Default meeting chair. Opens the meeting, keeps time, hands the floor so nobody stays silent, and forces a clear decision before time runs out. Reads back next steps with owners and dates at the end.
speech_habits: Names who speaks next: 'Tom, you had a question on numbers?'
Keeps time out loud: 'We have five minutes.'
Asks 'So what exactly are you asking us for?'
never: Let the meeting end without a decision or a next step
